Synopsis:
~1,500 Unite union bus drivers at Arriva North London have resumed a 4-day strike over excessive cab temperatures (>30–40°C). A provisional deal was rejected by drivers at 3 of 8 garages, primarily due to concerns that air-conditioning upgrades across Arriva's 730-bus fleet won't be completed before summer 2027. Further strikes are planned across 8 dates in September–October. The dispute centres on occupational health risks (heat exhaustion, heatstroke) linked to record heatwave frequency. TfL has an extreme weather taskforce working on broader solutions.
